# Only for tests/perf/tokens.py and its CI job: tiktoken and what it needs, pinned by hash (every file PyPI has for
# each version, so it installs on any system). Install with
#     pip install --require-hashes -r tests/perf/requirements.txt
# into a virtual environment. To update: pip install tiktoken==<version> into a new one, pip freeze, then list each
# file's sha256 from https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json. tiktoken checks the hash of the o200k_base file it
# downloads on first use.
